title: Aardvark-Vanaheim Cerebus #76 July 1985 - Varying Reasons Of Assorted Depths
descriptionText: The product is a vintage comic book from July 1985 in the US Comics tradition, specifically from the series Cerebus by artist and writer Dave Sim. Published by Aardvark-Vanaheim, this single issue comic features the character Cerebus in an adventure genre. The comic is in English and is part of the Copper Age era, making it a collectible item for fans of comic books and graphic novels.
